title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
description: The talks fail to make a breakthrough on tackling climate change after a row about mentioning fossil fuels.

title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
description: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.

title: Boss of British Gas owner Centrica 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
description: Chris O'Shea says the number of people unable or unwilling to pay their energy bills will increase when prices jump in the new year.

title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
description: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
description: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.

title: RAF's next fighter jet could be last crewed combat plane, air chief says
description: The head of the RAF said AI-enabled and uncrewed aircrafts are expected to start flying in UK airspace next year.

title: Russell Brand's wife says she'll honour prison rules after message row
description: The wife of the disgraced comedian says she will stick to the "parameters", after reading out a message from her inmate husband.

title: BBC apologises after noise disruption during Strictly
description: Strictly Come Dancing judge Motsi Mabuse was giving feedback to Delta Goodrem when she paused after the sound started playing.

title: How a teen gamer and his mother helped rescue a missing girl
description: When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping.
